title: Integrations & API
seo_description: Lab software integrations: connect Labora with lab instruments and business systems through its integration layer and API. Review your setup with our team.

fields.hero_title: Connect Labora with your instruments and systems
fields.hero_lead: Labora is designed to connect with lab instruments and other systems through its integration layer and API. Which connections are available depends on your analyzers and setup, so we review your equipment list with you.
fields.features:
Instrument readings and run files
REST API for your own tools
Identity and sign-in systems
Reporting and BI tools
Cloud storage for files and archives
Workflow and automation platforms

steps.title: Share your equipment list
steps.text: Tell us your analyzers, instruments, and the systems you already use.

steps.title: Plan the connections
steps.text: We map what Labora can connect to in your setup, and what each connection does.

steps.title: Go live
steps.text: Connections are set up and tested as part of your rollout.

fields.cta_title: See integrations and the API with your own setup
fields.cta_text: Bring your test menu and price list. We will show you a patient case from registration to signed report, configured the way your team works.
